# Create Notes

This release includes the Windows installer and an unsigned macOS .dmg.

## Install on Windows

1. Download the Windows installer from this release.
2. Run the installer.
3. Open Create Notes.

## Install on macOS

1. Download the unsigned macOS .dmg from this release.
2. Open the disk image and move Create Notes into Applications.
3. Allow the unsigned app once in System Settings, under Privacy & Security, then open Create Notes.
